ἑκάεργος: ἑκάεργος — far-working, far-shooter, epithet of Apollo (the second element is disputed); masc. nom. sg.
ἑκηβόλῳ: ἑκηβόλος — far-shooting (ἑκάς + βάλλω), epithet of Apollo; masc. dat. sg.
ἑλοῦσα: αἱρέω — take, take hold of; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)
ἑοῦ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive, epic enlarged ἑός) — his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. ἑοῦ, agreeing with παιδός
ἔβαλον: βάλλω — throw, cast, put down; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they cast out’
ἔδειραν: δέρω — flay; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they flayed’
ἔθεεν: θέω — run; impf. 3 sg., epic open -εεν (= Attic ἔθει): ’was running, sped on’
ἔκλυες: κλύω — hear; aor. 2 sg., + gen.: ’you heard’
ἔπειραν: πείρω — pierce; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they pierced’
ἔπειτά: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv., accented ἔπειτά before an enclitic (τοι)
ἔπλεο: πέλομαι — be, come to be; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented: ’you have come to be’ (= ἔπλευ)
ἔπλετ: πέλομαι — be, come to be; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔπλετ’ = ἔπλετο): ’has come to be’
ἔρον: ἔρος — desire, longing (= ἔρως); masc. acc. sg., object of ἕντο with ἐξ: ’put away desire’
ἔρυσσαν: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. 3 pl., epic doubled σσ (= Attic εἴρυσαν): ’they hauled’
ἔστησαν: ἵστημι — set up, stand; aor. 3 pl. act., transitive: ’set, stationed’ (the intransitive aor. has the same form: ’stood’)
ἔσφαξαν: σφάζω — slaughter, cut the throat of; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they slaughtered’
ἔτρεφον: τρέφω — nurture, rear, feed; impf. 1 sg.: ’I reared’
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’
ἕντο: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. put away (from oneself); aor. 3 pl. mid., in tmesis with ἐξ (ἐξ … ἕντο): ’they put away (desire)’
ἕποντο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented (ἕποντο = εἵποντο)
ἕρματα: ἕρμα — support, prop (stones or props under a beached ship); neut. acc. pl.
ἠέλιος: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. nom. sg.
ἠερίη: ἠέριος — early in the morning (or, others say, in the mist); fem. nom. sg., agreeing with the subject: ’early’
ἠπείροιο: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἠριγένεια: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’
ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj. (epic)
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’
ἰούσης: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. gen. sg., genitive absolute: ’as the ship went’
ἱλάσκοντο: ἱλάσκομαι — appease, propitiate; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’they were appeasing’
ἱλασόμεσθα: ἱλάσκομαι — appease, propitiate; aor. subj. 1 pl. mid., short vowel (= ἱλασώμεθα), after ὄφρα: ’that we may appease’
ἱστοδόκῃ: ἱστοδόκη — mast-holder, the crutch or rest that holds the lowered mast; fem. dat. sg.
ἴαχε: ἰάχω — cry out, resound, roar; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, of a loud natural noise
ἴκμενον: ἴκμενος — favourable, following (of a wind); masc. acc. sg., in the formula ἴκμενον οὖρον
ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’went’
ἴψαο: ἴπτομαι — press hard, smite, harm; aor. 2 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’you struck down’
ἵει: ἵημι — send, let go, throw; impf. 3 sg.: ’sent’
ἵκανεν: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’came to’
ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (short ι by metre; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented, which the spelling cannot show)
ὀβελοῖσιν: ὀβελός — spit; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
ὀλύμπιε: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; masc. voc. sg.
ὀφέλλωσίν: ὀφέλλω — increase, exalt; pres. subj. 3 pl., accented before the enclitic ἑ: ’may increase’
ὀϊζυρὸς: ὀϊζυρός — wretched, miserable; masc. nom. sg.
ὄνησα: ὀνίνημι — help, benefit; aor. 1 sg. act., + acc.: ’I helped’
ὄφελες: ὀφείλω — owe, ought; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented (ὄφελες = ὤφελες) with an inf. in a wish: ’would that you had’
ὅρμον: ὅρμος — anchorage, roadstead (cf. ὁρμίζω ’bring to anchor’); masc. acc. sg.
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος)
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’)
ὑφέντες: ὑφίημι — let down, lower; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having lowered’
ὑψοῦ: ὑψοῦ — on high, high up; adv.
ὠκεανὸν: Ὠκεανός — Oceanus, the river encircling the earth; masc. acc. sg.
ὠκυμορώτατος: ὠκύμορος — swift to one’s doom, short-lived; superlative ὠκυμορώτατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’the most short-lived’
ὠκυπόροισι: ὠκυπόρος — swift-going, swift-sailing; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις; a two-ending adjective), agreeing with νηυσί
ὠκύμορος: ὠκύμορος — swift to one’s doom, short-lived (ὠκύς + μόρος); masc. nom. sg.
ὠμοθέτησαν: ὠμοθετέω — lay raw pieces (on the burning offering) (ὠμός ’raw’ + τίθημι ’place’); aor. 3 pl., unaugmented
ὤπτησάν: ὀπτάω — roast; aor. 3 pl. act., accented before the enclitic τε
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥέξαι: ῥέζω — do, perform, esp. offer sacrifice; aor. inf. act.: ’to offer’
ῥηγμῖνι: ῥηγμίς — the line of breaking surf, the beach at the waterline (ῥήγνυμι ’break’); fem. dat. sg.
ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj., epithet of Dawn

__broaden__.αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg., reinforcing a pronoun: ’me myself’ (ἔμ’ αὐτὸν) · also plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν ’beside him’)
__broaden__.δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
__broaden__.κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’)
__broaden__.τοῖο: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic τοῦ); gen. of the person heard after ἀκούω: ’him’ · also temporal: ἐκ τοῖο ’from that time, after that’
__broaden__.τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’
